tasks.goal: Present your passport and booking reference code
tasks.hint: You have arrived at the check-in desk. Hand over your travel documents and state your confirmation number.
tasks.done_when: Learner presented their passport AND booking reference code.
tasks.scene_hint: The agent taps on the keyboard and looks up at the desk counter.

tasks.goal: Greet the agent and state your final destination
tasks.hint: Start the conversation politely. Greet the agent and mention the city you are flying to.
tasks.done_when: Learner greeted the agent AND stated their final destination.

tasks.goal: Confirm your flight number and departure time
tasks.hint: You want to make sure you are at the correct desk. Ask the agent to verify your flight details.
tasks.done_when: Learner confirmed their flight number AND departure time.

tasks.goal: Request an aisle seat for the flight
tasks.hint: You prefer easy access to the aisle during travel. Ask the agent if an aisle seat is available.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested an aisle seat for the flight.

tasks.goal: Ask to sit together with your travel companion
tasks.hint: You are traveling with a partner and want adjacent seats. Request two seats side by side.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked to sit together with their travel companion.

tasks.goal: Justify your eligibility for a transit visa exemption
tasks.hint: The agent asks for entry authorization. Explain why your layover duration exempts you from needing a visa.
tasks.done_when: Learner justified their eligibility for a transit visa exemption.

tasks.goal: Confirm your emergency contact details
tasks.hint: The agent asks for your contact details on file. Provide your updated phone number and emergency contact info.
tasks.done_when: Learner confirmed their emergency contact details.
tasks.scene_hint: The screen prompts the agent to update missing passenger contact fields.

tasks.goal: Inquire about seat selection options in your fare class
tasks.hint: You want to check seat availability before finalizing check-in. Ask what seating options remain.
tasks.done_when: Learner inquired about seat selection options in their fare class.

tasks.goal: Explain a name spelling discrepancy on your ticket
tasks.hint: Your middle name was misspelled during booking. Explain the typo to the agent and request a correction.
tasks.done_when: Learner explained a name spelling discrepancy on their ticket AND requested a correction.

tasks.goal: State your frequent flyer membership number
tasks.hint: You wish to accrue loyalty points for this journey. Provide your loyalty account number to the agent.
tasks.done_when: Learner stated their frequent flyer membership number.

tasks.goal: Place your suitcase onto the check-in scale
tasks.hint: The agent is ready to weigh your checked luggage. Inform them you are placing your bag on the scale.
tasks.done_when: Learner placed their suitcase onto the check-in scale.
tasks.scene_hint: A heavy rubber conveyor belt sits silent beside the metal weight scale.

tasks.goal: Inquire about the checked baggage weight limit
tasks.hint: You want to ensure your bag is within limits. Ask what the maximum weight allowance is for checked luggage.
tasks.done_when: Learner inquired about the checked baggage weight limit.

tasks.goal: Negotiate a fee waiver for a slightly overweight bag
tasks.hint: Your bag is one kilogram over the limit. Politely ask the agent to waive the extra charge as a courtesy.
tasks.done_when: Learner negotiated a fee waiver for a slightly overweight bag.
tasks.scene_hint: The digital scale display flashes a red warning number over the weight limit.

tasks.goal: Offer to remove heavy items to avoid baggage fees
tasks.hint: The agent flagged your suitcase as overweight. State that you will transfer some clothes to your carry-on.
tasks.done_when: Learner offered to remove heavy items to avoid baggage fees.

tasks.goal: Ask for a fragile sticker on your luggage
tasks.hint: Your checked bag contains delicate glass souvenirs. Request that the agent tag it as fragile.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked for a fragile sticker on their luggage.

tasks.goal: Inquire if your checked bags go straight to the final destination
tasks.hint: You have a connecting flight. Ask if you need to retrieve and re-check your bags during the layover.
tasks.done_when: Learner inquired whether checked bags transfer directly to the final destination.

tasks.goal: Negotiate special handling arrangements for an oversized musical instrument
tasks.hint: You are traveling with a cello. Request delicate oversized baggage processing without excessive extra fees.
tasks.done_when: Learner negotiated special handling arrangements for an oversized musical instrument.

tasks.goal: Request an exit row seat with extra legroom
tasks.hint: You are tall and want additional legroom. Ask for an exit row seat and confirm you meet safety criteria.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested an exit row seat with extra legroom.

tasks.goal: Inquire about paid cabin upgrade availability
tasks.hint: You want to travel in business class. Ask about upgrade prices and seat availability for your flight.
tasks.done_when: Learner inquired about paid cabin upgrade availability.

tasks.goal: Accept an offered seat change to a window seat
tasks.hint: The agent offers to switch your seat assignment. Confirm that you accept the window seat.
tasks.done_when: Learner accepted an offered seat change to a window seat.

tasks.goal: Ask about the layover duration for your connection
tasks.hint: You want to plan your connection time. Ask the agent how long you will wait between flights.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about the layover duration for their connection.

tasks.goal: Request a flight change due to a schedule conflict
tasks.hint: Your flight time was moved unexpectedly. Explain the conflict and request an earlier departure.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested a flight change due to a schedule conflict.
tasks.scene_hint: The departure status screen shows flight times updated in bright yellow lettering.

tasks.goal: Inquire about priority boarding procedures
tasks.hint: You want to board early with your ticket. Ask when and where priority boarding takes place.
tasks.done_when: Learner inquired about priority boarding procedures.

tasks.goal: Request permission to gate-check an oversized stroller without extra fees
tasks.hint: You are traveling with an infant stroller. Ask to use it up to the gate and check it free of charge.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested permission to gate-check an oversized stroller without extra fees.

tasks.goal: Declare lithium batteries inside your carry-on bag
tasks.hint: You have power banks in your hand luggage. Inform staff to confirm compliance with safety regulations.
tasks.done_when: Learner declared lithium batteries inside their carry-on bag.

tasks.goal: Inquire about lounge access privileges for your ticket
tasks.hint: You hold a business class fare. Ask the agent if complimentary airport lounge access is included.
tasks.done_when: Learner inquired about lounge access privileges for their ticket.

tasks.goal: Ask for directions to the security screening area
tasks.hint: You have completed check-in paperwork. Ask the agent where the main security checkpoint is located.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked for directions to the security screening area.

tasks.goal: Confirm liquid container volume limits for hand luggage
tasks.hint: You are entering the security line. Ask security staff to clarify the individual liquid container capacity.
tasks.done_when: Learner confirmed liquid container volume limits for hand luggage.
tasks.scene_hint: A plastic bin containing confiscated bottles sits next to the security queue line.

tasks.goal: Ask if laptop computers must be removed from carry-on bags
tasks.hint: You are preparing your belongings for the scanner conveyor. Ask if electronic devices need separate trays.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked if laptop computers must be removed from carry-on bags.

tasks.goal: Clarify footwear removal requirements at security
tasks.hint: You are approaching the walk-through metal detector. Ask if passengers must take off their shoes.
tasks.done_when: Learner clarified footwear removal requirements at security.

tasks.goal: Explain the presence of a metal joint replacement during screening
tasks.hint: The metal scanner alarm sounded as you passed. Inform security staff about your medical implant.
tasks.done_when: Learner explained the presence of a metal joint replacement during screening.
tasks.scene_hint: The archway metal detector emits an audible double beep as you step through.

tasks.goal: Request a private room for a manual security pat-down
tasks.hint: You prefer privacy for additional physical screening. Ask staff for a private inspection area.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested a private room for a manual security pat-down.

tasks.goal: Explain the contents of a flagged carry-on bag
tasks.hint: An officer pulled your bag aside for inspection. Clarify that the object inside is a souvenir metal snowglobe.
tasks.done_when: Learner explained the contents of a flagged carry-on bag.
tasks.scene_hint: An officer places your carry-on bag onto a stainless steel inspection table.

tasks.goal: Propose alternative arrangements for a prohibited liquid container
tasks.hint: Your expensive liquid exceeds the volume limit. Ask if you can mail it home or return it to check-in.
tasks.done_when: Learner proposed alternative arrangements for a prohibited liquid container.

tasks.goal: Ask about special meal requests for your flight
tasks.hint: You pre-ordered a vegetarian meal. Confirm with the agent that your dietary preference is recorded.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about special meal requests for their flight.

tasks.goal: Complain about a severe flight delay causing a missed connection
tasks.hint: Your flight is delayed four hours. Express concern about your tight connection and demand a resolution.
tasks.done_when: Learner complained about a severe flight delay causing a missed connection.
tasks.scene_hint: A chime sounds over the public address system announcing flight delays.

tasks.goal: Request specialized assistance for a passenger with mobility limitations
tasks.hint: You need help navigating the terminal. Request staff to arrange an escort or wheelchair service.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested specialized assistance for a passenger with mobility limitations.

tasks.goal: Confirm the departure gate location and walking distance
tasks.hint: You want to budget your time before boarding. Ask where your gate is located and how long it takes to walk there.
tasks.done_when: Learner confirmed the departure gate location AND walking distance.

tasks.goal: Request compensation for an involuntary class downgrade
tasks.hint: You were moved from business to economy class due to overbooking. Request official reimbursement.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested compensation for an involuntary class downgrade.

tasks.goal: Inquire about standby list procedures for an earlier flight
tasks.hint: You arrived early at the terminal. Ask if you can put your name on the standby list for an earlier departure.
tasks.done_when: Learner inquired about standby list procedures for an earlier flight.

tasks.goal: Ask about pet travel guidelines for cabin transport
tasks.hint: You are traveling with a small dog in a carrier. Confirm cabin entry rules with the agent.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about pet travel guidelines for cabin transport.

tasks.goal: Negotiate a seat reassignment away from a broken recline mechanism
tasks.hint: The agent mentions your assigned seat does not recline. Explain your long journey and request a different seat.
tasks.done_when: Learner negotiated a seat reassignment away from a broken recline mechanism.

tasks.goal: Inquire about duty-free purchase pickup locations
tasks.hint: You bought goods online before traveling. Ask where to collect duty-free merchandise past security.
tasks.done_when: Learner inquired about duty-free purchase pickup locations.

tasks.goal: Request meal vouchers during an extended flight delay
tasks.hint: Your departure was postponed by five hours. Request food and beverage vouchers for the long wait.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested meal vouchers during an extended flight delay.

tasks.goal: Ask for assistance locating a lost boarding pass
tasks.hint: You misplaced your printed pass after security. Ask staff how to obtain a replacement document.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked for assistance locating a lost boarding pass.

tasks.goal: Confirm baggage tag destination codes
tasks.hint: The agent is printing luggage tags. Ask to check that the airport code matches your destination.
tasks.done_when: Learner confirmed baggage tag destination codes.
tasks.scene_hint: A thermal printer whirs while printing sticky barcode baggage tags.

tasks.goal: Negotiate hotel accommodation after a cancelled flight
tasks.hint: Your evening flight was cancelled until tomorrow. Request a hotel voucher and overnight transport.
tasks.done_when: Learner negotiated hotel accommodation after a cancelled flight.

tasks.goal: Ask if duty-free liquids are allowed through transit security
tasks.hint: You bought sealed duty-free wine. Ask if it can pass through security during your connecting airport layover.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked if duty-free liquids are allowed through transit security.

tasks.goal: Inquire about family seating policies
tasks.hint: You want to make sure your child is seated next to you. Ask the agent to confirm family seating rules.
tasks.done_when: Learner inquired about family seating policies.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'voucher'
tasks.hint: A voucher is a coupon or document redeemable for specific goods or services. Inquire if the counter offers one for meals during a long wait.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'voucher'.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'liable'
tasks.hint: Liable means legally responsible or financially obligated for an outcome. Ask whether you are held responsible for damages to fragile baggage.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'liable'.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'exempt'
tasks.hint: Exempt means excused from a rule, duty, or payment requirement. Inquire whether your essential medical device is excused from standard carry-on limits.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'exempt'.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'expedite'
tasks.hint: Expedite means to accelerate or speed up the progress of an action. Ask if staff can speed up your security screening for a tight connection.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'expedite'.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'discrepancy'
tasks.hint: A discrepancy is an illogical disagreement or variance between facts or records. Point out a difference between your reservation confirmation and the monitor.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'discrepancy'.

tasks.goal: Ask if quiet zone seating is available
tasks.hint: You want to work in a quiet environment on board. Inquire about quiet zone cabin availability.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked if quiet zone seating is available.

tasks.goal: Pay the excess baggage fee with a credit card
tasks.hint: The agent calculated your overweight baggage fee. Hand over your payment card to finalize the charge.
tasks.done_when: Learner paid the excess baggage fee with a credit card.
tasks.scene_hint: The payment terminal screen displays the total balance due for excess baggage.

tasks.goal: Ask for a payment receipt for baggage fees
tasks.hint: You paid for excess luggage and need proof for expense reporting. Ask the agent for an itemized receipt.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked for a payment receipt for baggage fees.

tasks.goal: Receive your printed boarding passes
tasks.hint: The agent is handing over your travel documents. Confirm receipt of your physical boarding passes.
tasks.done_when: Learner received their printed boarding passes.

tasks.goal: Confirm your luggage claim check stubs
tasks.hint: The agent attaches barcode stickers to your ticket folder. Verify that you have claim stubs for both checked bags.
tasks.done_when: Learner confirmed their luggage claim check stubs.

tasks.goal: Inquire about exact boarding time and gate closing
tasks.hint: You want to avoid missing your flight. Ask what time boarding begins and when the gate doors close.
tasks.done_when: Learner inquired about exact boarding time AND gate closing.

tasks.goal: Accept an upgraded seating assignment offered due to flight overbooking
tasks.hint: The agent explains the economy cabin is overbooked and offers a complimentary seat upgrade. Accept the offer.
tasks.done_when: Learner accepted an upgraded seating assignment offered due to overbooking.

tasks.goal: Confirm baggage re-check instructions when the agent mentions an international layover
tasks.hint: The agent explains you must collect and re-check bags during transit. Confirm the luggage transfer steps.
tasks.done_when: Learner confirmed baggage re-check instructions for an international layover.

tasks.goal: Confirm the lounge directions and entry pass details
tasks.hint: You are departing the check-in desk for the lounge. Ask the agent to confirm how to access the entrance.
tasks.done_when: Learner confirmed the lounge directions AND entry pass details.

tasks.goal: Verify your updated boarding gate after a schedule adjustment
tasks.hint: The departure gate was modified last minute. Confirm the new gate number with airport staff.
tasks.done_when: Learner verified their updated boarding gate after a schedule adjustment.
tasks.scene_hint: The gate monitor displays a flashing notice showing a gate reassignment.

tasks.goal: Request a priority security lane pass after the agent mentions a tight departure window
tasks.hint: The agent points out your flight boards very soon. Ask for an expedited fast-track security voucher.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested a priority security lane pass for a tight departure window.

tasks.goal: Ask where to return a borrowed luggage cart
tasks.hint: You are done moving your suitcases to the counter. Inquire where to return the luggage trolley.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked where to return a borrowed luggage cart.

tasks.goal: Confirm passport return before departing the counter
tasks.hint: You are wrapping up check-in. Make sure the agent hands back your physical passport and ID.
tasks.done_when: Learner confirmed passport return before departing the counter.

tasks.goal: Thank the agent for assistance and say goodbye
tasks.hint: Your check-in process is complete. Express appreciation to the agent and wish them a pleasant day.
tasks.done_when: Learner thanked the agent for assistance AND said goodbye.

tasks.goal: Agree to gate-check your carry-on roller bag when the agent warns of full overhead bins
tasks.hint: The agent warns overhead storage is full on the aircraft. Agree to gate-check your carry-on bag.
tasks.done_when: Learner agreed to gate-check carry-on luggage due to limited overhead space.
